presets.name: German Payslip
presets.description: German Lohn-/Gehaltsabrechnung. Detects Steuerident-Nr., Rentenversicherungs-Nr., Krankenversicherungs-Nr., IBAN, German dates, German phone numbers, German street addresses and PLZ + city.

presets.name: Italian Busta Paga
presets.description: Italian payslip. Detects Codice Fiscale, Partita IVA, Matricola INPS, IBAN, Italian dates and phone numbers, plus names, addresses. Disables the noisy 'Amounts' detector so salary figures aren't over-redacted.

presets.name: US W-2 / Pay Stub
presets.description: US tax forms and pay stubs (W-2, W-4, 1099, generic paystubs). Detects SSN, EIN, US dates, US ZIP codes, US phone numbers, bank routing numbers (context-anchored), plus names, addresses, account numbers and amounts.

presets.name: US Medical Records
presets.description: US medical records and clinical notes. Detects patient names, DOB (multiple formats), MRN (6+ digit runs without decimals), SSN, full US addresses, ZIP, emails and phones. Preserves lab values by ignoring numbers with commas/periods.

presets.name: UK Medical Records
presets.description: UK hospital and GP records. Detects NHS numbers, UK dates (dd/mm/yyyy and long form), UK postcodes, UK phones, NI numbers, hospital numbers and patient names. Preserves lab values.

presets.name: Generic Invoice
presets.description: Generic invoice or receipt. Detects invoice numbers, dates, EU VAT IDs, IBAN, BIC/SWIFT (context-anchored), international phones, plus names, addresses, emails. Amounts kept visible — toggle Amounts manually to hide totals too.

presets.name: Bank Statement
presets.description: Bank or credit card statement. Detects IBAN, BIC/SWIFT (context-anchored), masked card numbers, full card numbers (13-19 digits), transaction references, dates, international phones, plus names, addresses, account numbers and amounts.

presets.name: Common Surnames (US + Canada)
presets.description: Opt-in preset that hides ~10,400 common surnames across the US and Canada — top 10k US Census 2010 plus curated French-Canadian, Scottish/Irish-Canadian, Asian-Canadian, and Eastern European immigrant surnames very common in Canadian rosters. For guest lists, reservation calendars, employee rosters. False positives expected on common-word surnames (Brown, Green, Stone) — opt-in tradeoff.

presets.name: Italian Fattura
presets.description: Italian invoice (fattura). Detects Partita IVA, Codice Fiscale, IBAN, the SDI recipient code, Italian dates and phone numbers, plus names, addresses and emails. Amounts kept visible so line items stay readable.

presets.name: Italian Atto / Contratto
presets.description: Italian legal deed or contract (atto notarile, contratto). Detects Codice Fiscale, Partita IVA, IBAN, the notarial Repertorio/Raccolta number, Italian dates and phone numbers, plus the names and addresses of the parties and emails.

presets.name: Italian Visura
presets.description: Italian company or cadastral record (visura camerale / catastale). Detects Partita IVA, Codice Fiscale, REA number, cadastral references (Foglio / Particella / Subalterno), IBAN, Italian dates and phone numbers, plus names and addresses.

presets.name: German Rechnung
presets.description: German invoice (Rechnung). Detects USt-IdNr, Steuernummer, IBAN, BIC/SWIFT, German dates, phones, street addresses and PLZ + city, plus names and emails. Amounts kept visible.

presets.name: German Personalausweis
presets.description: German ID card (Personalausweis) or passport copy. Detects the Ausweisnummer, CAN/Zugangsnummer, Steuer-ID, the machine-readable zone (MRZ), date of birth and German addresses, plus names. Pair with manual redaction for photo and signature.

presets.name: German Kontoauszug
presets.description: German bank statement (Kontoauszug). Detects IBAN, BIC/SWIFT, Bankleitzahl (BLZ), Kontonummer, German dates, phones and addresses, plus account holder names. Amounts kept visible so you can prove income while redacting identities.

presets.name: German Führerschein
presets.description: German driving licence (Führerschein) copy. Detects the Führerscheinnummer, date and place of birth, issue/expiry dates and German addresses, plus names. Pair with manual redaction for photo and signature.

presets.name: Spanish DNI / NIE
presets.description: Spanish ID (DNI) or foreigner ID (NIE) copy. Detects the DNI (8 digits + letter), NIE, the support number (IDESP), dates of birth and Spanish addresses, plus names. Pair with manual redaction for photo and signature.

presets.name: Spanish Factura
presets.description: Spanish invoice (factura). Detects NIF / CIF / DNI, IBAN, Spanish dates and phone numbers, plus names, addresses and emails. Amounts kept visible.

presets.name: Belgian Legal Documents (FR)
presets.description: Belgian legal documents in French (citations, conclusions, actes). Detects the BCE company number, cadastral references, Belgian addresses and postal codes, company names by legal form, IBAN, plus names. Amounts in € stay visible.
